name: Goblin's TradeOFF
source:
You're a prison guard stationed at a new goblin prison camp. One evening while on duty, a gobbo gal sparks a conversation - and she has a compelling offer for you!

Will you give her your meat, or will you ignore her yapping?

[From [url=https://moxigames.itch.io/goblins-tradeoff]itch.io[/url]]
